component.name: ChatQT
component.summary: A simple AI chat client for OpenAI-compatible providers

description.p: ChatQT is a native KDE application that provides a simple and intuitive interface for chatting with AI models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Multiple provider support: Connect to OpenAI, OpenCode, or any OpenAI-compatible API.
Simple interface: Clean and intuitive design built with Kirigami for a seamless experience.
Native KDE integration: Built with Qt/QML for seamless Plasma desktop experience.
Chat management: Clear chat history and control auto-scroll behavior.
Bug fix release addressing thinking display and Flatpak tray icon issues.

ul.li: Fix thinking/reasoning content not displaying in the collapsible block for OpenAI-compatible providers
Fix system tray icon not appearing in the Flatpak build
Removed default skill folder paths (users now add folders manually)

description.p: This is the first stable release of ChatQT, a native AI chat client for KDE Plasma built with Qt6, QML, and Kirigami.

ul.li: Connect to Ollama with automatic model discovery
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, etc.) with multi-provider support and connection testing
Streaming responses with real-time token-by-token display
Toggle extended thinking/reasoning for supported models
Persistent chat sessions with sidebar navigation and auto-restore on launch
MCP (Model Context Protocol) support: Streamable HTTP remote servers and stdio-based local servers
Pre-configured built-in MCP servers (Bash and Filesystem) with configurable tool call depth
Skill discovery: scan folders for SKILL.md files and inject them as system prompts
Load AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files for persistent AI agent instructions
System tray integration for minimizing and quick access
Experimental providers (disabled by default): OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Pi agent
